en.t: This place really is as picturesque as a painting.

units.source_text: 在风景如画的地方画画，正是你的行当，真是天堂呀！”

en.t: Painting in a place as beautiful as a painting is exactly your line of work; it must be heaven!

units.source_text: 姐夫用平庸的目光瞧了瞧山，又瞧了瞧他和画布。

en.t: My brother-in-law looked at the mountain with his ordinary eyes, then looked again at him and the canvas.
